violation_type.title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)
violation_type.typical_finding: Smoke detectors, carbon detectors and fire extinguishers were not inspected monthly.

finding_variants.text: Smoke detectors, carbon detectors and fire extinguishers were not inspected monthly.
The smoke detector have not bee checked/tested monthly.
Documentation of monthly smoke detector testing was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
The smoke detector has not been tested monthly.
Smoke detector testing is not documented for the 2025 calendar year.
There was no documentation showing monthly testing of the carbon monoxide and smoke detectors or monthly checks of the fire extinguisher.
